name: Hyperliquid
description: Hyperliquid is a layer-1 blockchain with a fully on-chain order book for perpetual futures and spot trading, plus the HyperEVM smart-contract environment; HYPE is its native token. The official app takes USDC deposits from Arbitrum.
description_zh: Hyperliquid 是一条一层区块链，内置完全链上的永续合约与现货订单簿，并提供 HyperEVM 智能合约环境；HYPE 是其原生代币。官方应用接受来自 Arbitrum 的 USDC 存款。

geo_site.method: The app calls the info API legalCheck for the visitor's IP; restrictions 'a' (BlockActions) disables trading and the app shows "Not available in your jurisdiction". IP geolocation by IPdata (Privacy Policy). The blocked countries are those where legalCheck answered 'a' to the live probe (see the observations; 2026-10-12: US, US-NY, CA-ON, CU, IR, MM, SY); Terms 1.6 name the United States and Ontario (plus unnamed sanctioned territories).

geo_feature.scope: Outcome markets (contracts that settle on the outcome of an event) are hidden where legalCheck answers 'o' (HideOutcomes) or 'u' (Uk: outcome markets hidden plus the app's UK-specific flow). The countries are those of the live probe (see the observations; 2026-10-12: 19 of 62 countries, among them DE, FR, GB, JP, SG, CA).

vpn.note: Terms forbid VPNs or proxies to conceal location.

screening.provider: Chainalysis (the app's 'flagged by Chainalysis' banner) via info API legalCheck userAllowed

tos.restricted: Terms 1.6: United States, Ontario (Canada), persons in sanctioned jurisdictions (not named) and their citizens

notes: The app asks the info API legalCheck with the connected wallet (or a placeholder address): the answer carries userAllowed (wallet screening) and restrictions for the visitor's IP. Builder-code frontends call legalCheck themselves. The country list is not published in code; the bundled Terms 1.6 name it.
live: api.hyperliquid.xyz/info legalCheck (2026-10-12): SDN -> userAllowed:false; control -> userAllowed:true

api_probes.name: legalCheck
api_probes.note: The IP check the app runs on load, with the app's own placeholder address.

rules.note: restrictions=o (HideOutcomes): the app hides outcome markets
restrictions=u (Uk): the app hides outcome markets and runs its UK flow

evidence: app.hyperliquid.xyz bundle: legalCheck call, BlockActions=`a`, 'Not available in your jurisdiction'
app.hyperliquid.xyz bundle: TermsOfUse 1.6, PrivacyPolicy (geo-blocking by IP address using IPdata)
